overview_description.description:
Cityfurnish is an internet company that specializes in the fields of e-commerce and online rental. It features an online renting zone where contemporary and modern styles amalgamate to establish a new genre of wooden furniture and furnishings.

The company was founded in 2015 and headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana.

product.name: Furniture Rental
product.description: Service allowing customers to rent various types of furniture for flexible periods, typically from 3 to 12 months, with delivery, installation, and maintenance included.

product.name: Home Appliance Rental
product.description: Rental service for home appliances including refrigerators, washing machines, TVs, water purifiers, and microwaves with free delivery, installation, and maintenance.

product.name: Office Furniture Rental
product.description: Rental of office furniture including ergonomic chairs, desks, and workstations with delivery, assembly, and maintenance services.

product.name: Ready-Made Furniture Combos
product.description: Pre-packaged sets of furniture and appliances bundled for specific room types or needs, available for rent with delivery and installation.

product.name: Flexible Rental Plans and Payment Options
product.description: Various rental tenure and payment plans including monthly, quarterly, and yearly options with no-cost EMI and cancellation policies.
